stem: What was one benefit of Whaley winning the Readers’ Choice Hero of the Year award?

options.label: A
options.text: He was able to focus on a new career.

options.label: B
options.text: He was able to choose an experienced president for his organization.

options.label: C
options.text: He received advice about how to be an effective soccer coach.

options.label: D
options.text: He was able to use the prize money to help his organization.
